about: The starter sample library: CC0 one-shots, vocals, keys, FX, risers and loops the producer can play. Every entry carries its provenance chain (source, url, via, attribution). Kits map the six drum roles to one-shots; any missing sound falls back to the synthesized kit.
processing: Converted with ffmpeg to 44.1 kHz mono 16-bit WAV (128 kbps mono MP3 for items longer than 4 s), peak-normalized to -1 dBFS; one-shots had leading silence below -45 dB stripped and were trimmed to their musical length. Provenance chain for every file is in url, via and attribution. Every Freesound source page was fetched on 2026-09-02 and showed Creative Commons 0.
